source_snapshot.procedure: Collect full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists, filter PWR, inspect BMC Web and retain anomalies.
source_snapshot.criteria: Both list forms and Web match SPEC; numbering is 1, 2, 46.
source_snapshot.script: No Script; Config-Check; 3/0 minutes; shared code across rows 2028, 2202 and 2274.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES/ipmitool but invents a title sensor, truncates OOB-only evidence and contaminates expected output with PDB from another variant.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; isolates row-2028 PWR, requires topology/aggregation map and defines optional independent-reference boundary.

old_problem: Generic PWR matching can mix PSU input/output, rail, device and board aggregates or double-count hierarchy levels. The code is duplicated at rows 2202 and 2274 for different INA/OVRM and PDB-temperature objects, and DeepSeek leaks the PDB label into this row. No decision existed on whether `Check` meant interface parity or calibrated accuracy.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict under ED-02 by binding this review to Source Key Functionality|2028 and Variant 465c39de1bd9b963 while preserving the other same-code rows separately. ED-03 parameterizes the complete PWR population/topology/load state, and ED-15 requires approved limits. Default scope is passive management-plane reporting; an independent calibrated reference is added only when the Project SPEC explicitly requires accuracy and supplies a safe procedure.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2028, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, duplicate-code manifest identities and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; next row was directly opened as Functionality 2029 / Wistron-BMC-01048-V002 / 4ae7d2e234134388.
Rows 2028/2202/2274 share a code but not an object: this row remains PWR power reading, row 2202 INA/OVRM telemetry and row 2274 PDB temperature; none can satisfy another.
Every PWR member is bound to source, load, electrical domain and aggregation level so input/output/subtotal/total values are not compared or summed incorrectly.
Complete IB/OOB/Web agreement proves reporting parity. Calibrated accuracy is graded only when a separate approved reference, uncertainty, timing, load stabilization and tolerance are supplied.
Criteria 1, 2 and 46 are retained without inventing 3-45; DeepSeek's PDB label is rejected as wrong-variant contamination.
No ipmitool, power query, independent meter, authentication, Web capture, load/power change, live probe, log clear or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Variant-isolated power-domain PWR reporting with optional calibrated-reference comparison
test_case.purpose: Verify every row-2028 PWR member is mapped to the correct source/load/domain/aggregation level and reports fresh SPEC-consistent power across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web; validate accuracy only if an approved independent reference is explicitly required.
required_package: Exact row-2028 Source Key/Variant and SUT/BMC/board/PSU/VR identities; rows 2202/2274 exclusion list
Complete PWR population and power-topology matrix with source/load/domain/aggregation relationships
Versioned units/scaling/load-dependent range/limits/state/freshness/cadence rules and documented workload/redundancy state
Approved ipmitool and protected OOB/Web access
If accuracy is required: approved calibrated meter/reference, safe connection procedure, uncertainty, stabilization/alignment and tolerance; power/BMC owner plus human Web/verdict ownership
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; verify row-2028 variant identity and exclude row-2202 INA/OVRM and row-2274 PDB-temperature objects. Freeze workload/power/redundancy state. Preserve logs and capture complete aligned IB/OOB `sdr elist` and `sensor list` before PWR selection plus every Web member. Compare source/load/domain/aggregation, units/scaling/value/state/limits/freshness to SPEC without double-counting. Only under a separately approved accuracy package, compare an aligned calibrated reference. Do not target the title/PDB label, truncate, live-probe, alter load/power/thresholds, clear logs or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: All row-2028 PWR members appear exactly once at the correct topology and aggregation level with fresh SPEC-valid consistent management-plane fields; if accuracy is required, aligned values meet the approved reference tolerance. No wrong-variant evidence or power fault is present.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS for reporting requires exact variant isolation, complete topology/population and full five-view evidence meeting approved rules. Accuracy PASS additionally requires the calibrated reference package. FAIL on wrong-variant substitution, missing/extra/duplicate/stale member, aggregation error, mismatch, exceeded approved limit/tolerance or power fault. Missing topology/limits/reference when required is NOT READY; user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Default scope is passive telemetry; no live probing or power/load/threshold changes. Independent measurement requires separate explicit authorization and safe procedure.
Preserve Source Key/Variant, credentials, full raw inventories and power/SEL context.
Stop on variant ambiguity, aggregation conflict, power alarm, mismatch, stale data or unsafe reference setup.
No automatic retry or log clearing; preserve the first power state and discrepancy.
expected_evidence: Exact row-2028 Source Key/Variant/hash and same-code rows 2202/2274 isolation audit
Complete power topology/PWR population with source/load/domain/aggregation and versioned rules
Full timestamped IB/OOB SDR and Sensor-list outputs with exits/hashes
Complete BMC Web evidence for every PWR member
Per-member comparison and double-count analysis with workload/power/redundancy context
Optional calibrated-reference ID/certificate/setup/uncertainty/alignment/tolerance result; numbering/no-probe/no-clear/no-retry audit and verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong variant/target, access failure, aggregation ambiguity, mismatch, power alarm or unsafe reference setup, stop and preserve state. Close sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Disconnect a separately approved meter only by its recovery procedure. Do not alter power/load, clear logs or retry; escalate the exact domain/member.

source_conflict.reason: Source Key/Variant isolation quarantines same-code INA/OVRM and PDB-temperature rows; a topology/aggregation matrix and explicit reporting-versus-accuracy contract remove remaining ambiguity.

blocked.reason: Passive reporting semantics, optional metrology boundary, safety and recovery are complete; topology/limits/reference parameters are Project Configuration.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Row-2028 PWR population/topology/aggregation map, units/scaling/load rules and optional calibrated-reference package only when accuracy is required.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED TO VARIANT-ISOLATED POWER-DOMAIN REPORTING; NO IPMITOOL, POWER QUERY, REFERENCE METER, AUTHENTICATION, WEB CAPTURE, LIVE PROBE, LOAD/POWER CHANGE, LOG CLEAR OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED

external_authorities.title: ipmitool sensor-list implementation
external_authorities.application: Supports passive SDR-backed reads; it does not define OEM power hierarchy or calibrated accuracy.

external_authorities.title: OpenBMC IPMITOOL cheat sheet
external_authorities.application: Supports complete list capture for independent IB/OOB interface evidence.

project_authority: Power/platform/BMC owners supply PWR topology, aggregation and limits and decide whether accuracy is in scope; a human validates Web evidence and verdict. Same-code variants remain separate and an external meter is never silently introduced.
